profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software engineer at Delaget. Experienced full-stack developer, utilizing C#, React.js/Redux, and JavaScript.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Redesigned application database, API, and UI to include an audit logging feature, allowing users to support
and troubleshoot their own processes thus decreasing support channel requests by at least 60%
• Collaborated and worked closely with product owners to draft requirements and designs for 3 new web
application features, in addition, drafting up timelines for Agile projects
• Troubleshooted and debugged user requests and questions in support channel, ranging from business-
critical, performance issues, to High Priority Incidents within the required SLA

positions.title: IS Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Worked with a team of experienced developers, and work through entire development lifecycle, creating program specifications through coding, implementation and testing 
• Designed documentation, develop software programs using OpenEdge ABL or WebSpeed (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, AJAX, OpenEdge ABL), and communicated with manufacturing plant managers 
• Worked independently to create test plans and thoroughly test and debug all programs prior to implementation

volunteerExperiences.description:
• Volunteering in a peer mentorship program with high school students with differing abilities working on soft skills or coping techniques. 

• A mentor for entry level seminar course, designing class curriculum and activities. Leading discussions.

• Supervised and instructed students through the Girls Who Code curriculum using classroom demos,
individual walk-throughs, and pair programming
